# Old WordPress site — content reference

Extracted 2026-08-24 from the UpdraftPlus database backup in `old wordpress live/wp-content/updraft/`, before that folder was deleted. Source site: esteqo.com (WordPress, "Meni" theme). Kept for reference only — none of this was imported into the live `esteqo` database or copied into any service/page code.

Only genuinely real ESTEQO content is included below — the WordPress install also had ~30 unused theme demo pages (Typography, Portfolio, Pricing Table, fake team members like "Bruce Lane"/"Caroline Doss", Latin lorem-ipsum portfolio items, etc.) which are NOT included since they were never real content.

## Faq  (`/faq`, page, id 19636)

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Morbi
 
 
 
We encourage your feedback, please feel free to send us a message
using the following contact form.
ESTEQO is a luxury aesthetic and skin clinic founded by Seema Nanda, specializing in brows, lasers, and advanced skincare treatments. We offer Medi-Facials, Laser Hair Reduction, Brow Design, Anti-Aging therapies, and more  all customized for your skin type.
Absolutely. Every treatment at ESTEQO is customized for your skin’s condition and sensitivity. We use medical-grade technology and dermatologically approved products to ensure comfort and safety for all skin types.
Our “Book Appointment” page
Phone: 08010135135Our team will confirm your slot and help with pre-treatment guidance.
Avoid applying makeup, exfoliating products, or retinol 24 hours before your facial or laser session. Our experts will guide you with detailed instructions depending on your treatment.
We recommend every 3–4 weeks for best results. Regular Hydra Facials help maintain hydration, unclog pores, and keep your skin glowing year-round.
The Hydra Facial focuses on deep cleansing, hydration, and rejuvenation.
The Carbon Laser Facial uses activated carbon and laser light to target pigmentation, acne, and dullness. Both can be combined for enhanced glow and clarity.
Laser Hair Reduction offers long-term results by significantly reducing hair growth (up to 90%). Multiple sessions (6–8) are usually needed depending on the area and hair type.
Yes, absolutely. ESTEQO specializes in acne-safe treatments like Hydra Clean-Up and OxyGeneo Facials. These are gentle yet effective for sensitive or acne-prone skin.
“Brows by Seema” is ESTEQO’s signature brow artistry service — offering Brow Mapping, Microblading, Tinting, and Lamination. Each session is tailored to enhance your natural features and create perfect symmetry.
Microblading results typically last 12–18 months, depending on your skin type and aftercare routine. A touch-up session after 6–8 weeks is recommended for long-lasting definition.
Not at all. We use numbing creams and gentle techniques to ensure maximum comfort. Clients usually describe it as a mild scratching sensation rather than pain.
Yes! Many clients combine their Hydra Facial + Brow Design in one session. It’s completely safe and saves time while delivering a complete glow makeover.
